description: Reference schema for the resume_embeddings pgvector table. Rows are produced by app.chunking.resume_chunker.chunk_resume_json() using RecursiveJsonSplitter, then stored via app.db.pgvector_client.upsert_resume_embeddings().

splitter_config.description: Splits resume JSON by semantic boundaries (section objects). Each chunk covers one logical section slice.

resume_file_id.description: Unique identifier for the resume document (typically filename or UUID)

chunk_index.description: 0-based sequential index of the chunk within this resume

dimension.description: Semantic dimension tag. One of the 8 values in dimension_values below.

chunk_text.description: Serialised JSON string of the chunk data produced by split_json_to_chunks()

chunk_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of chunk_text. Used for deduplication on upsert.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached by the chunker (e.g. source section name)

technical_skills.notes: Flat list of skill strings from the resume.skills array

experience_fit.text: {"section": "experience", "entry": {"title": "Senior ML Engineer", "company": "Acme Corp", "start": "2021-01", "end": "present", "description": "Led model deployment pipelines...", "responsibilities": ["Designed RAG pipelines", "Optimised vector search"]}, "dimension": "experience_fit", "source": "resume", "chunk_index": 2, "chunk_hash": "c9d3..."}
experience_fit.notes: One chunk per experience entry. Includes title, company, dates, description, responsibilities.

certification_fit.text: {"section": "certifications", "items": ["AWS Certified Solutions Architect", "Google Professional ML Engineer"], "dimension": "certification_fit", "source": "resume", "chunk_index": 6, "chunk_hash": "e2f5..."}

domain_fit.text: {"section": "projects", "entry": {"name": "Resume Scoring System", "description": "Built an enterprise RAG validation pipeline...", "technologies": ["LangGraph", "pgvector", "FastAPI"]}, "dimension": "domain_fit", "source": "resume", "chunk_index": 7, "chunk_hash": "f3a6..."}
domain_fit.notes: Project entries and resume summary. Captures candidate's domain/industry fit.

salary.notes: Salary expectation from resume. Used for salary_score comparison against JD salary range.

identity.notes: Candidate PII fields. Kept separate for access-control filtering.

schema.text: string — serialised JSON string of chunk data
schema.chunk_hash: string — SHA-256 hex of text field

search_result_row.description: Row format returned by app.db.pgvector_client.search_resume_embeddings(resume_file_id, query_embedding, dimension, top_k)

upsert_behaviour.on_conflict: DO UPDATE SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, chunk_text = EXCLUDED.chunk_text, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
upsert_behaviour.description: Idempotent upsert. Re-processing the same resume replaces stale embeddings only when chunk content changed (hash mismatch).
